extracted text: The 2219 aluminum alloy used in this experimental investigation was provided in the T62 condition. The T62 temper designation for the alloy refers to a heat treatment, which involved solution heat treat at 995 F (535 °C) for 40 min followed by water quench and then artificially aged at 375 F (191 °C) for 36 h. Two different sheet conditions were analyzed: Sheet A (non-anodized) and Sheet B (anodized with thin film sulfuric acid anodized and water sealed). Both sheets have the same T62 temper.
